glosses: The son of Adam and Eve who was killed by his brother Cain.

examples.text: And Cain talked with Abel his brother: and it came to pass, when they were in the field, that Cain rose up against Abel his brother, and slew him.

examples.text: Dan was er Abel, die klassieke talen studeerde en vaker van wal stak over zaken die niemand werkelijk begreep, al hadden ze geleerd dat je ja moest knikken en snel van onderwerp veranderen.
